editorial:
You follow ex-cop Billy Taggart as he gets pulled back into a messy city scandal after the mayor uses him and then tries to bury him. The story mixes street-level grit with political games, so you get a crime thriller that feels personal and tense. Mark Wahlberg plays Billy with rough charm, while Russell Crowe makes the mayor feel smooth, dangerous, and always one step ahead. The city itself feels worn down and corrupt, which gives every scene a heavy mood without slowing things down too much.

The best parts are the confrontations, the steady pacing, and the way Billy keeps pushing even when the odds look bad. Some twists are easy to guess, and a few side characters do not get enough time, but the movie still keeps you engaged. If you like crime stories with political drama, this is a solid pick. Watch it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the sharpest picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Billy uncovers the mayor's full scheme and proves he was framed. The mayor tries to use his power to escape, but Billy exposes the truth and clears his name. The ending leaves you with a sense of justice, though the city still feels broken. Billy walks away changed, having faced the corruption head-on and finally won his redemption.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime thrillers with political drama.
